text:
maria: Anyone seeing a spike in SCIM deprov failures for the service-account sync? Started ~03:40 UTC. Okta logs show 502, our provisioner shows KMS "invalid ciphertext" intermittently.
kevin: Yep, got the same alerts. Paging SRE oncall. @ian can you take a look? :eyes:
ian: On it, grabbing logs and traces.
ian: Sample from provisioner: ```2026-06-15T03:41:12Z provisioner=svc-account-deprov error=decrypt_failed key_arn=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234 error_msg="invalid ciphertext" ciphertext_id=ci-abc1234```
maria: We rotated the customer KMS alias yesterday for extid rewrap. Could be related to alias propagation or a rewrap that missed some ciphertexts.
kevin: If key rotation broke rewrap we'd expect persistent failures. Intermittent suggests rollout or caching. Any deploys to provisioner around 03:30?
maria: Yes — we promoted async-batching change at 03:36 (10% -> 100% rollout completed).
ian: Rolling the change back to 10% now to test correlation.
deploy-bot: rollback started: release-2026.06.15-provisioner (100% -> 10%) by maria
sre-oncall: Mitigation: pausing deprovision for service-account role in the queue to avoid orphan deletions; enabling retry queue with longer backoff.
kevin: Good. Also open a KMS support ticket (include ciphertext_id and sample). For short term: add decrypt retry (exp backoff) and verbose logging that includes ciphertext_id and key_arn. Maria, can you confirm ciphertext_id captured in logs?
maria: Confirmed — sending a full sample in the ticket: ```ciphertext_id=ci-abc1234 ciphertext=BASE64... key_arn=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234```. Attaching to ticket now.
ian: Rollback verification: error-rate dropped ~90% in last 3m after rollback to 10%. Continuing to monitor.
security: Please ensure audit logs capture who triggered the KMS rotation and the rewrap job run IDs — we need that for post-incident compliance review.
maria: Noted, will dump rotation job logs and add to incident thread.
kevin: Action items: 1) keep rollback until we validate rewrap correctness; 2) implement retries + more logging; 3) open KMS support ticket w/ sample; 4) postmortem + playbook (KMS rotation rollback playbook + rollout gating). I'll own the postmortem. Thanks everyone.
